title: Lack of information on material composition
text: Lack of information on material composition. It works. What I am not happy with is that there is NO information on the materials used to make these bags.  There is a sheen on them, no odor.  In this world of disclosure and my choice to ingest: I like to know what I am putting in my tea.  I think Amazon should put a base line of expected information to be disclosed and quality control where possible.  This item does not appear to be 100% cotton.
